name: crash-issue-fixer
description: Investigate and fix crash, non-fatal and ANR issues from Firebase Crashlytics (through the Firebase MCP server or the console in Chrome) or pasted from any crash reporter: checks whether each issue is already fixed, traces native iOS/Android stacks back to the app's code (including React Native and Flutter), proposes root-cause fixes that are applied after approval, and can file the results as GitHub issues.
